SQLite Template Default

nodes.label: Embedded App Session Navigation
nodes.rationale: Use React Router Link/useSubmit and redirects returned by authenticate.admin to preserve the embedded user session.

nodes.label: App-specific Webhook Configuration
nodes.rationale: Declare subscriptions in shopify.app.toml so deploy synchronizes configuration; shop-specific afterAuth subscriptions do not update during ordinary development.

nodes.label: Shopify AI Toolkit
nodes.rationale: Required for Shopify API/platform work; tooling belongs in the agent host rather than this repository.

nodes.label: Expiring Offline Access Tokens
nodes.rationale: Upstream template adopted offline access-token rotation and refresh token fields.

nodes.label: Client Offer Allocation Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Each client special offer snapshots total allocation and splits it between client discount and designer commission.

nodes.label: Commission Adjustment Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Each commission adjustment records adjustment amount and resulting commission to preserve the financial audit trail.

nodes.label: Shopify Webhook Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Configured topics are app/uninstalled, app/scopes_update, orders/create, orders/cancelled, and orders/updated; API version is 2026-07.

nodes.label: Active Baseline Migration
nodes.rationale: Located in prisma/migrations and creates the baseline schema.

nodes.label: Development Prisma Client Reuse
nodes.rationale: Cache the Prisma client on global.prismaGlobal outside production; otherwise instantiate when no cached client exists.

nodes.label: Shopify Development Host Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Copy legacy HOST into SHOPIFY_APP_URL when appropriate, then delete HOST to avoid breaking the Vite server.

nodes.label: Local and Tunnel HMR Configuration
nodes.rationale: Local development uses ws at port 64999; remote development uses wss with client port 443 and configurable frontend port.
